shots.intent: 用一句配方主张加情绪猫像在首屏一秒建立点击理由

shots.intent: 把核心营养利益转成猫主人的情感投射，巩固首屏主张

shots.textZone: six labels with tiny EN captions under the grid; centered serif headline with EN serif word and thin rules in the white band

shots.intent: 全幅颗粒微距呈现酥松质地与天然色泽，证明用料新鲜
shots.textZone: upper 40% band: grey serif EN word, navy serif headline, grey micro caption

shots.intent: 用编号大数字讲清配方机制四要点，完成理性说服
shots.textZone: top red ribbon banner; four numbered rows each with bold white headline and two-line grey-blue micro note

shots.intent: 把营养数据可视化成环绕颗粒的气泡图，让成分看得见

shots.intent: 仰头接粮的生活切片让主人代入喂食瞬间的期待感

shots.intent: 四枚标签加配方徽章做信任收束，把利益转成安心感
shots.textZone: four chip labels in the white zone; emblem panel vertical label plus two headline-and-note benefit blocks in the navy band

shots.intent: 三行喂食量表给出按体重喂多少的确定感，扫清最后顾虑
shots.textZone: three-column table header and three data rows; bold lead-in line and two-line micro paragraph below the table

shots.intent: 以坚持喂食后的状态对比加行动按钮完成收口转化
shots.textZone: left-aligned two-line headline stack above a thin rule; two panel labels; bottom CTA button text with accent note chip
